news.title: Quantile Regression Caught the House Price OLS Missed by $55K
news.dek:
On 88 house sales, OLS predicted $164K for a $219K home, while a 90% interval from 5th and 95th percentile models spanned $136K to $227K. 
 The post  Quantile Regression Caught the House Price OLS Missed by $55K  appeared first on  Towards Data Science .
news.aiSummary: On a dataset of 88 house sales, Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) predicted a home's value at $164K, missing its actual $219K price by $55K. In contrast, a 90% interval generated by 5th and 95th percentile Quantile Regression models spanned $136K to $227K, successfully capturing the true house price.
